output_list.criticism: The vulnerability arises due to the following code snippet: function Goutex( uint256 initialSupply, string tokenName, uint8 decimalUnits, string tokenSymbol) public token (initialSupply, tokenName, decimalUnits, tokenSymbol) public {...} The problem lies in the constructor function, no modifier is used for initialization which makes the contract vulnerable to common attack vectors such as Re-Entrancy and Token Mismanagement.

The vulnerability arises due to the following code snippet: function approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) public returns (bool success) {...} The problem lies in the approve function, no modifier is used for approve which makes the contract vulnerable to common attack vectors such as Token Mismanagement.
